Now, as a 50-year-old with a love for philosophy and computer science, I see math as a tool for understanding patterns in the world, not a barrier.

replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried a free AI math tutor app last year for basic algebra. I’d recommend it for beginners but not for advanced topics like calculus or linear algebra.

If it’s positive, there are two real solutions; if zero, one real solution; if negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). Practice with simple examples to build confidence.
